data.body: **[P1] Keep suspended CONTEXT operations non-recording.** `on_user_function_start()` still creates a recording, deterministic CONTEXT span, so this cleanup exports it when the invocation becomes PENDING. Replay then creates and exports another span with the same trace/span ID when the context completes, allowing collectors to overwrite or reject the authoritative terminal span. Use a non-recording CONTEXT placeholder until `on_operation_end()` materializes the sole recording span, and add a child-context suspend/replay test asserting one terminal export.
